entries.title: Still Wakes the Deep
entries.definitive_edition: Still Wakes the Deep plus Siren's Rest on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release and install Siren's Rest after completing the main story.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 5 PC presentation with PC settings and capture flexibility.

primary.version: Steam release plus Siren's Rest DLC
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best complete route because it has the full Unreal Engine 5 base game, PC capture/settings flexibility, and the Siren's Rest story expansion on the same platform. Steam/Epic PC builds also have broader PC upscaling/settings flexibility than the PC Game Pass/console family.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Still Wakes the Deep on Steam, then play the Siren's Rest DLC after finishing the main story because its public description warns of end-game spoilers.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Unreal Engine 5 PC release with Steam/Epic settings flexibility and the Siren's Rest DLC available on PC.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity complete route when paired with Siren's Rest.

all_releases.fidelity: Current-generation console release; Siren's Rest is also available on PS5.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete console route, but no sourced exclusive content and less PC capture/settings flexibility.

all_releases.fidelity: Current-generation console release; Siren's Rest is also available on Xbox Series X/S and Xbox via PC.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete console route, but no sourced exclusive content and less PC capture/settings flexibility.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The story expansion is available on the PC primary route, so no separate platform is needed for completeness.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is needed; Siren's Rest is a paid story expansion and should be played after the base game.
